corrections.reason: Joining across the line wrap (L17-L18) gives እንደምን ነው አይጣላም ቢሉ ('How is it that it does not contradict, if they ask?'). Visually, the first character on L17 after ። is እ (6th order) forming እንደምን across the line break, not አንድም.
